entities.summary: Elena Kotova is a Russian writer, interior architect, and private real estate developer. She worked as an international financer and held senior banking positions in Russia, USA, and Europe from 1994 to 2010. She was charged with soliciting a bribe in 2013 and given a suspended five-year jail sentence in 2014.
